Question:
Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker,
        b.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
qualified_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE match_total_runs > 50
),
striker_total_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        q.striker,
        SUM(smr.match_total_runs) as total_runs
    FROM qualified_strikers q
    JOIN striker_match_runs smr ON q.striker = smr.striker
    GROUP BY q.striker
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_total_runs
